authorityPrecedence: Newest explicit owner feedback and direct live-Figma comparison against locked P01/P02 CURRENT pages override earlier grouped-regeneration PASS declarations.

visualMaster.rule: Use P03 Visual Master for local composition, hierarchy, photo count and information relationships, but it does not license a different illustration genre from the active V30 publication family.

liveFigma.rule: Update CURRENT 3535:11 only. Do not create a duplicate P03 and do not modify P01/P02/P04-P08.

crossPageStyleAnchors.principle: P03 may have a different page role and composition, but major display art, papers, tropical/travel ornaments and story graphics must look selected by the same publication art director as P01/P02.
v30StyleDNA: crisp printed/sticker-like silhouettes rather than painterly illustration plates
strong dark outlines or equivalent high-contrast edge definition on high-saliency display art
white/yellow/bright keylines and controlled dimensional shadows where useful
clean cream/white paper surfaces with clear colored framing rather than aged parchment
tropical/travel motifs rendered as lively editorial cutouts/stickers, not watercolor botanical studies
tactile print character is allowed but texture stays restrained and graphic
mixed media is allowed only inside a bounded realism/texture range that still reads as one V30 publication
hardRejects: watercolor or painterly botanical illustration as a dominant high-saliency P03 language
aged parchment / sepia scrapbook treatment that is absent from P01/P02
fine-art tropical/church rendering that reads like an illustration plate
one page mixing painterly vintage blocks with flat SVG flowchart elements
passing a page merely because each object is individually attractive while the page family is inconsistent

ownerRejectedCurrentTargets.reason: These current implementations either drift from the active P01/P02 V30 visual family or preserve the flowchart/isolated-icon assembly problem. Do not preserve them merely because a previous grouped-regeneration run marked them PASS.

newGroupedProductionModel.principle: Use fewer, larger editorial ecologies. Do not solve P03 with isolated clipart/SVG parts, but also do not flatten the whole page.

blocks.styleRule: Match P01/P02 V30 graphic/sticker/print energy. No watercolor, vintage parchment, painterly botanical or retro-poster treatment.
Use clean bright publication paper comparable to P02 editorial cards, not aged parchment/scrapbook paper. Q3/Q4 stay non-identical but clearly same V30 family.

include: camera/palm and only necessary fixed local accents
blocks.photoRule: Step1-4 support photos remain independently replaceable; Step5 remains no-photo.
blocks.styleRule: Read as one irregular magazine story composition. The route is editorial movement, not a connector diagram. Do not retain the orange dotted-line + separate SVG-like icon/heart-label grammar.
hardRejects: five separate heart badges next to an independent dotted connector

blocks.styleRule: Support the page in the same bold editorial cutout/sticker family as P01/P02. No watercolor church, realistic botanical plate, painterly tide or vintage travel-poster treatment.

microOrnamentRule.principle: P03_STEP3_CAMERA, P03_STEP2_PALM, P03_HERO_LOWER_PLUMERIA and similar accents do not survive as isolated assets by default. Integrate them into the nearest grouped ecology when genuinely needed, otherwise remove them.
microOrnamentRule.hardReject: Do not regenerate a new isolated icon simply because the old isolated icon was rejected.

executionOrder: read latest remote authority and compare current P01 3535:7, P02 3535:9 and P03 3535:11 side-by-side before generating
calibrate one P03 grouped style sample against P01/P02 V30 family before producing all replacements
rebuild Header ecology in V30-aligned graphic language
rebuild Q3/Q4 as one calibrated bright editorial-paper family
rebuild Timeline + fixed local accents + Wedding Day/date as one grouped Story ecology
rebuild Bottom closure in V30-aligned graphic language
remove superseded isolated camera/palm/plumeria/route/label/Wedding-Day nodes after replacements win visually
run one full-page P01/P02/P03 cross-page comparison plus P03 Visual Master/A5 review
run alpha/material and fingerprint checks only on new grouped blocks
completionCondition: P03 may return to FIGMA_DESIGN_COMPLETE=YES only when a direct P01/P02/P03 side-by-side review passes CROSS_PAGE_STYLE_FAMILY_PASS and the timeline reads as one authored story ecology rather than a flowchart, without flattening photos or pending body copy.
